principle: Teleon interoperates with the common agent frameworks BOTH directions: (1) EXPORT a governed capability as a framework-native tool (MCP/OpenAI/Anthropic/LangGraph/CrewAI/AutoGen) so any framework can call a governed capability; (2) WRAP a framework agent as a governed CANDIDATE behind a port (sandboxed, never serves truth). Frameworks are how capabilities are consumed + candidate runtimes to govern — never a second source of truth. Teleon imports no framework; it emits/consumes specs.

frameworks.wrap_as: an MCP-server agent as a governed candidate behind a port
frameworks.export_governance: the exported tool carries the capability's receipt + serves_truth=false (a governed capability, not a bare function)
frameworks.wrap_governance: the framework agent runs sandboxed as a CANDIDATE; output is evidence, never truth; a gate promotes
